vocabulary.usage: Used in prayers and religious texts to reference divine beings
Essential in agricultural records describing irrigation and water rights
Appears in inventory tablets recording grain storage and taxation
Found in administrative seals and royal decrees

usageExample.text: 100 𒊺 (100 measures of grain) delivered by Farmer Enuma to King's warehouse
usageExample.meaning: This type of record helped manage early economies and taxation systems

vocabulary.usage: Sacred symbol representing eternal life, worn by gods and pharaohs
Central to solar theology and appears in temple inscriptions daily
Critical in records of floods, harvests, and abundance
Used in royal decrees and tomb inscriptions to identify rulers

usageExample.text: ☥ Pharaoh blessed by 𓇳 with 𓈗 abundance for eternal 𓂀 rule
usageExample.meaning: This blessing formula appears on temple walls, connecting the pharaoh's divine right to the natural cycles of the Nile
